title: Console UX launch: sprint orchestration and staged training cadence for dashboards, rollouts, and cost breakdowns
creator: Asha Kothari
description:
Scope: Coordinate launch activities for three linked Console UX features landing in console-2025.03: 1) per-route dashboards (latency/cost/usage), 2) rollout controls and canary UX, and 3) token-level cost breakdowns. This ticket centralizes cross-team orchestration: release notes, internal enablement, external messaging, training cadence, and launch day runbook.

Goals: Ensure a coherent developer-facing narrative across docs and release notes, prepare internal support and sales with training and playbooks, and align engineering/QA/design timelines so the public rollout meets SLA and observability expectations.

Success metrics:
- Official release notes published with section-level examples and migration notes (by 2025-03-10).
- Two live training sessions (recorded) for Support and Sales with >80% attendance from target lists.
- In-console tour and help center articles live at GA with acceptance signoff.
- Fewer than 3 customer-facing bugs in first 72 hours post-GA attributable to documentation gaps.

Stakeholders: Product (Asha Kothari), Engineering leads (Lina Chen, Raj Patel), Design (Morgan Park), Developer Relations (Noah Garcia), Support (Priya Singh), Sales Enablement (Evan Torres), Legal/Privacy (for any messaging referencing customer telemetry).

Channels & artifacts: PRD and rollout checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Console-UX-Dashboards-Rollouts-PRD, design spec and annotated screenshots: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEF_console_dashboards_designs, engineering PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1245 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789, internal demo dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/internal/cost-breakdown-demo.

Key alignment items:
- Finalize release notes draft (PM) -> Engineering review of copy for accuracy -> Legal review of telemetry examples.
- Design to provide in-console screenshots, copy snippets, and tour assets by 2025-02-20.
- Engineering to provide feature flags and rollout window and confirm autoscaling/billing impacts by 2025-02-28.
- Support to create triage runbooks and common troubleshooting Q&A by 2025-03-05.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Late design changes that invalidate screenshots. Mitigation: Freeze visual assets three working days before release and add contingency screenshots for small diffs.
- Risk: Cost breakdown reveals unexpected high variability. Mitigation: Add a pre-GA telemetry check with sampling and include 'beta' label in release notes if thresholds not met.

Communication plan summary:
- Internal: Weekly cross-functional sync (PM/Eng/Design/Support/Sales) on Tuesdays; #console-launch Slack channel for day-to-day coordination.
- External: Blog + release notes + in-console release banner; staged rollouts (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with monitoring gates between phases.

Notes: This ticket is focused on orchestration and content (release notes, training, runbooks). Engineering work streams and design tasks remain in their respective tickets (listed in dependencies).
acceptance_criteria: Release notes draft in repo and Confluence with examples and migration notes, approved by Engineering and Legal
Two live training sessions scheduled and recorded for Support and Sales; slides and Q&A captured in Drive
In-console help articles and guided tour live at GA with screenshots and copy from Design
Cross-team launch checklist completed and signoffs captured (PM, Eng Lead, Design Lead, Support Lead)
Rollout gating criteria defined and telemetry dashboard for monitoring set up prior to 10% rollout
comments: 2025-02-11 - Asha Kothari: Kickoff completed. Shared draft PRD with teams; Lina (Eng) to confirm feature flag behavior and suggested rollout windows by end of week. Created #console-launch channel for ops.

2025-02-14 - Lina Chen: Engineering will target feature-flagged 10/50/100 rollout. Noted a dependency on ENG-4783 for metric tagging; ETA for metric fixes 2025-02-25. Will update observability docs once metrics land.

2025-02-18 - Morgan Park (Design): Finalized hero screenshots and tour wireframes. Uploaded assets to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEF_console_dashboards_designs. Requesting copy freeze by 2025-02-20 to avoid last-minute UI text changes.

2025-02-20 - Priya Singh (Support): Drafted triage runbook with top 6 known issues and escalation playbook. Will run a dry-run session with Support on 2025-03-03. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Support-Runbooks

2025-02-24 - Asha Kothari: Release notes skeleton created and shared in Confluence. Legal review requested for telemetry examples (submitted 2025-02-24). Also created a short customer-facing FAQ to include in release notes.

2025-02-25 - Noah Garcia (DevRel): Customer beta cohort identified (10 customers across infra and platform segments). Preparing demo scripts and invite email copy. PR for demo notebook: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1245
rollout_plan_summary: Phased rollout: 1) Beta cohort (10 customers) for 48h monitoring and feedback; 2) 10% of GA-eligible tenants for 72h with telemetry gates (error rate, latency, cost variance thresholds); 3) 50% expansion if gates pass; 4) 100% GA. Each phase requires explicit signoff from Eng Lead and PM. Contingency: immediate rollback to previous UX and a customer-facing note if critical issues detected.
